description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Industrial Disputes between, P. K. Ajantha Vs. Southern Province Road Development Authority and two other notices
categorisation: This gazette content contains orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, which involves the appointment of arbitrators to settle industrial disputes. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it represents the exercise of statutory powers under existing legislation to address specific legal disputes between parties. The content does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
